count.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total
      FROM barbershops b
      INNER JOIN barbershop_locations bl ON bl.barbershop_id = b.id
      WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (
      bl.status = 'CONFIRMED'
      AND bl.latitude IS NOT NULL
      AND bl.longitude IS NOT NULL
      AND bl.latitude >= -90.0 AND bl.latitude <= 90.0
      AND bl.longitude >= -180.0 AND bl.longitude <= 180.0
      AND (
        CASE
          WHEN (bl.source = 'GOOGLE' OR bl.google_place_id IS NOT NULL OR bl.google_reference IS NOT NULL) THEN (
            bl.source = 'GOOGLE'
            AND bl.acquired_at IS NOT NULL
            AND bl.valid_until IS NOT NULL
            AND bl.acquired_at <= NOW()
            AND bl.valid_until > NOW()
            AND bl.valid_until <= (bl.acquired_at + INTERVAL '25 days')
            AND (bl.acquired_at + INTERVAL '25 days') >= NOW()
          )
          WHEN bl.source = 'MANUAL' AND bl.google_place_id IS NULL AND bl.google_reference IS NULL THEN (
            bl.valid_until IS NULL OR bl.valid_until > NOW()
          )
          ELSE FALSE
        END
      )
    ) AND bl.latitude BETWEEN $1::double precision AND $2::double precision AND bl.longitude BETWEEN $3::double precision AND $4::double precision
        AND (
      2.0 * 6371000.0 * asin(sqrt(
        least(1.0::double precision, greatest(0.0::double precision,
          power(sin(radians(bl.latitude - $5::double precision) / 2.0), 2) +
          cos(radians($6::double precision)) * cos(radians(bl.latitude)) * power(sin(radians(bl.longitude - $7::double precision) / 2.0), 2)
        ))
      ))
    ) <= $8::double precision

SELECT
        b.id,
        b.name,
        b.slug,
        b.location,
        b.avatar_url,
        bl.latitude,
        bl.longitude,
        (
      2.0 * 6371000.0 * asin(sqrt(
        least(1.0::double precision, greatest(0.0::double precision,
          power(sin(radians(bl.latitude - $1::double precision) / 2.0), 2) +
          cos(radians($2::double precision)) * cos(radians(bl.latitude)) * power(sin(radians(bl.longitude - $3::double precision) / 2.0), 2)
        ))
      ))
    ) AS distance_meters
      FROM barbershops b
      INNER JOIN barbershop_locations bl ON bl.barbershop_id = b.id
      WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (
      bl.status = 'CONFIRMED'
      AND bl.latitude IS NOT NULL
      AND bl.longitude IS NOT NULL
      AND bl.latitude >= -90.0 AND bl.latitude <= 90.0
      AND bl.longitude >= -180.0 AND bl.longitude <= 180.0
      AND (
        CASE
          WHEN (bl.source = 'GOOGLE' OR bl.google_place_id IS NOT NULL OR bl.google_reference IS NOT NULL) THEN (
            bl.source = 'GOOGLE'
            AND bl.acquired_at IS NOT NULL
            AND bl.valid_until IS NOT NULL
            AND bl.acquired_at <= NOW()
            AND bl.valid_until > NOW()
            AND bl.valid_until <= (bl.acquired_at + INTERVAL '25 days')
            AND (bl.acquired_at + INTERVAL '25 days') >= NOW()
          )
          WHEN bl.source = 'MANUAL' AND bl.google_place_id IS NULL AND bl.google_reference IS NULL THEN (
            bl.valid_until IS NULL OR bl.valid_until > NOW()
          )
          ELSE FALSE
        END
      )
    ) AND bl.latitude BETWEEN $4::double precision AND $5::double precision AND bl.longitude BETWEEN $6::double precision AND $7::double precision
        AND (
      2.0 * 6371000.0 * asin(sqrt(
        least(1.0::double precision, greatest(0.0::double precision,
          power(sin(radians(bl.latitude - $8::double precision) / 2.0), 2) +
          cos(radians($9::double precision)) * cos(radians(bl.latitude)) * power(sin(radians(bl.longitude - $10::double precision) / 2.0), 2)
        ))
      ))
    ) <= $11::double precision
      ORDER BY distance_meters ASC, b.id ASC
      LIMIT $12
      OFFSET $13
